embed_texts: Recipe used hf_config on PyTorchModel (Olive Studio builder) Older Olive Studio recipes emitted type PyTorchModel with hf_config. Olive 0.13+ PyTorchModelHandler rejects hf_config; Hugging Face sources must use HfModel. Rebuild the recipe in Olive Studio (Input → Parse & Apply or re-enable passes). Current Studio builders emit HfModel for Hugging Face IDs. If you imported raw JSON, change input_model.type to HfModel and keep model_path as the HF id. hf_config unexpected keyword argument 'hf_config' unexpected keyword argument "hf_config" PyTorchModelHandler PyTorchModel

Apply Fix or chat Apply did not change pipeline state The diagnostic had no mappable updated_config (applyable=false), or the patch keys are not in Olive Studio's UI mapping (for example data_configs-only remedies). Follow the Recommended Fix text manually. For calibration data_configs, set Dataset / user script in Input. For chat suggestions, use Apply only when an action card is shown; plain advice has no patch. Apply Fix no auto-applyable updated_config Fix Applied Apply did nothing

Olive MCP package missing or mcp 2.x broke FastMCP import Olive Studio's MCP server needs mcp<2 (FastMCP lives under mcp.server.fastmcp in 1.x). Wrong venv or mcp 2.x removes that path. In olive-mcp-server: pip install -e ".[dev]" "mcp<2". Restart the MCP / app process. Prefer the project .venv used by Olive Studio. mcp.server.fastmcp No module named 'mcp' mcp<2 ModuleNotFoundError: mcp cannot import name FastMCP

Assistant provider not active in Olive Studio Chat/Audit call the server AI runtime. Downloading a local model does not switch Active Provider until Settings saves the provider/model. Open Assistant → Settings, select the provider (Ollama, OpenRouter, …), pick/load the model, Save. Confirm the sidebar header shows the active provider. No AI provider configured Active Provider provider not set Load model Ollama Assistant → Settings

Diagnose could not reach Olive MCP tools Olive Studio proxies Diagnose through POST /api/mcp/tool → olive_mcp_server.call_tool. Missing package install, wrong Python, or an unknown tool name yields empty/failed diagnosis. Install olive-mcp-server into the app .venv (pip install -e olive-mcp-server "mcp<2"). Restart pnpm dev. Re-run Diagnose; you should see title/root_cause from the KB. Unknown tool: call_tool Diagnosis failed Diagnosis returned an unexpected /api/mcp/tool olive_mcp_server

TensorRT install used a bare version pin Olive Studio Hardware install must pass a package name (for example tensorrt==…) not a lone ==version string. Use Hardware → Install for TensorRT / TensorRT RTX, or pip install tensorrt==<version> / tensorrt-rtx explicitly in the app .venv. Retry after a successful install. Invalid requirement ==10.9.0.34

Pulled recipe JSON did not update the pipeline UI Olive Studio GitHub shortcuts and Pull from GitHub load JSON into the Editor tab only. Pipeline toggles change after Parse & Apply. Open the Editor tab, confirm the JSON, then click Parse & Apply. Shortcuts intentionally do not auto-apply. Parse & Apply JSON editor Pull from GitHub shortcut recipe not applied

Isolate Olive Studio cache directory for this experiment Shared cache_dir across experiments can make multi-pass outputs hard to reason about in Studio. Set a unique cache directory in Infrastructure / workspace settings, then re-run. cache_dir Olive Studio cache experiment cache intermediate overwrite

TensorRT RTX execution provider not registered Consumer TensorRT RTX path needs both the tensorrt-rtx package and a matching ONNX Runtime EP-ABI plugin build, not the full nvinfer TensorRT SDK. Missing install or SM < 7.5 leaves NvTensorRTRTXExecutionProvider unregistered. Install both tensorrt-rtx and the matching ONNX Runtime EP-ABI plugin (Hardware → Install TensorRT RTX, or pip in the app venv). Requires NVIDIA GPU SM ≥ 7.5 (Turing+). Verify NvTensorRTRTXExecutionProvider appears in onnxruntime.get_available_providers(). Prefer AWQ INT4 (NVModelOpt) over PTQ INT8/QDQ for this EP. Restart the app after install. NvTensorRTRTXExecutionProvider tensorrt-rtx TensorRT RTX TensorRT RTX not registered NvTensorRTRTX

DirectML execution provider missing or wrong venv DirectML requires Windows 10/11 + DirectX 12 and onnxruntime-directml in the default-family venv. CUDA/GPU ORT wheels do not expose DmlExecutionProvider. On Windows, install onnxruntime-directml into the Olive Studio default venv (Hardware → DirectML or pip). Do not mix CUDA/TRT packages into the DirectML EP path. Non-Windows hosts cannot run DirectML. DmlExecutionProvider DirectMLExecutionProvider onnxruntime-directml DirectML DirectML EP

WebGPU is browser-only — local Execute Live blocked WebGpuExecutionProvider targets ONNX Runtime Web in the browser. Olive Studio marks WebGPU recipes non-runnable locally (isRunnable: false / localExecutionIssues). Use Export recipe / download ONNX for in-browser ORT Web WebGPU. Prefer FP16 (OnnxFloatToFloat16). Do not expect Execute Live or local Olive CLI to run WebGPU. WebGpuExecutionProvider WebGPU webgpu ORT Web WebGPU browser WebGPU

OpenVINO NPU needs target device NPU (not EP rename) Intel NPU still uses OpenVINOExecutionProvider. The device is selected separately via openvinoTargetDevice (or equivalent). Without device=NPU and the OpenVINO NPU driver, work stays on CPU. In Olive Studio set OpenVINO target device to NPU. Install the OpenVINO NPU driver on Intel Core Ultra / Meteor Lake+. Prefer OpenVINO weight-compression or INT8 paths; verify unsupported ops are not silently falling back to CPU. OpenVINO NPU device NPU openvinoTargetDevice": "NPU" openvinoTargetDevice: NPU Core Ultra NPU device=NPU
